title: DURING WHICH MR. FOGG AND PARTY CROSS THE PACIFIC OCEAN
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg reunites with Passepartout in Yokohama, and the entire party boards the steamer General Grant to cross the Pacific.
summary_detail: After boarding the Yokohama steamer off the coast of Shanghai, Fogg, Aouda, and Fix arrive in Yokohama. There, Fogg discovers Passepartout working in a theatre troupe. Reunited and re-clothed, they board the General Grant to cross the Pacific to San Francisco. During the voyage, Fix and Passepartout agree to a truce, and the ship arrives exactly on schedule.
